title: India To Get AI Law, Union Minister Ashwini Vaishnaw Says Centre Will Issue Consultation Paper Soon
script:
India is moving to regulate AI through a formal government framework.
Union Minister Ashwini Vaishnaw confirmed the government will issue a consultation paper soon.
This upcoming document marks the first major step toward a structured legal roadmap.
The ministry plans to seek public feedback to shape these new standards.
Officials intend to address ethical concerns while still supporting domestic technological progress.
The Union Minister stated this process begins shortly to define the country's AI direction.
Would you support strict government oversight for all AI models?
